create_gemma4_processor: create a Gemma4Processor instance with feature_extractor, image_processor, tokenizer, and video_processor for multimodal input handling
call_gemma4_processor: call the Gemma4Processor with images, text, audio, and videos to tokenize and process multimodal inputs into a BatchFeature
compute_audio_num_tokens: compute the number of audio soft tokens for a waveform by replicating the audio encoder's sequence-length arithmetic
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of placeholder tokens needed for multimodal inputs given image sizes and audio lengths
create_mm_token_type_ids: create multimodal token type IDs from input IDs to distinguish text tokens from multimodal placeholder tokens
